scope: Displayed fields only, after removing HTML tags: argument title, pro_html, con_html, gaps explanation; claim title, statement, scope_html, background_html, support_html, objection_html; background statement and scope_html; evidence node html. Audit fields are excluded: original, edits, note_routes, review_evidence, display_replacements, paths, members, reason, classification_reason.
quotation_exception: A phrase is allowed only inside curly quotation marks that match its bound source. The gate should check the source match, not only the marks.
limit: This list catches known wording. It does not prove that no other editorial verdict exists.
phrases: does not rule the argument out
break in the chain of reasoning
not a defect in the reasoning
still support how the effect would work
rather than whether it gives a reason
